subject: Control Alignment Workbook and Artifact Intake — Stratos Financial SIG
messages:
From: Elaine Chung <elaine.chung@stratos-fin.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@stratos-fin.com
Date: 2028-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG Nexus submission + requested evidence window

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG Nexus export for the initial legal/security review (filename: stratos_sig_nexus.pdf). Our procurement and compliance teams are aligned that we need: (1) a control-level mapping to Redwood controls, (2) a shortlist of representative artifacts for each control grouping (audit logs, key management evidence, configuration screenshots), and (3) confirmation of any responsibilities that would remain with Stratos under a private deployment.

Timebox: can you provide a draft mapping and list of artifacts by end of day Thursday (2028-04-19)? Our Security Ops team will triage and request any follow-ups. A couple of early clarifications we need:
- Do you surface tenant-level audit logs for Dedicated and Private deployments, and what retention windows are configurable?
- For KMS: do customers bring their own keys (BYOK) for Private, and do you offer HSM-backed key management in Dedicated?

We prefer artifact delivery via a shared Drive link (see compliance process attached in the SIG export). If you have a pre-filled workbook we can review, please upload it there and notify the compliance mailbox.

Thanks,
Elaine Chung
Senior Manager, IT Risk & Compliance
Stratos Financial

Attachment: stratos_sig_nexus.pdf (SIG Nexus export; 12 pages)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chung <elaine.chung@stratos-fin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Nexus submission + requested evidence window

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the Nexus export and the clear scope. We'll take ownership of the control mapping and the initial artifact shortlist. Proposed plan:
1) Today (EOD): share a pre-filled mapping workbook that aligns Stratos SIG items to Redwood control IDs and the likely artifact candidates.
2) Thu 04/19: deliver the first-pass artifact list for your review (screenshots, sampling of audit logs, KMS proof-of-ownership doc).
3) Follow-up week of 04/22: provide any additional documentation or short recordings (technical walk-through) as requested.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Audit logs: For Hosted + Dedicated we provide tenant-level logs with adjustable retention; default retention is 90 days but this is configurable on Dedicated and Private. We'll include a short doc showing the retention settings and log export example.
- KMS: For Private, yes — BYOK is supported; customers can bring keys and integrate with their KMS/HSM. For Dedicated we support HSM-backed KMS via partnership; we'll include architecture notes and the attestation text we use in contracts.

I'm looping in Marissa (security intake lead) and Neha (evidence coordinator) to pick up artifact collection. Marissa — can you take point on filling the mapping workbook and outline the intake checklist? Neha — please prepare an internal list of owners and ETA for each artifact.

I'll upload the workbook to your Drive link once we have the draft.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx (draft workbook)
From: Elaine Chung <elaine.chung@stratos-fin.com>

Date: 2028-04-17T08:27:00-07:00

Jonas,

Thanks — that plan works. A couple of follow-ups from our side after a quick scan of the Nexus export:
- Our compliance team will expect evidence showing separation of duties for administration vs. platform ops. Can you indicate where (which control IDs) you document admin role definitions and where screenshots/role exports will be provided?
- We will also want a sample of API-level audit log schema (column names) and one redacted log file showing a typical access event. Is that feasible?

Logistics: the Drive folder is shared with your marissa.cole@redwood.ai address. If you prefer a secure upload instead, we can issue a temporary SFTP token (let us know).

Finally, please call out any controls that are partially customer-managed in Private mode (e.g., network ACLs, customer SIEM forwarding).

Elaine
